resolved_conflicts.explanation: Hartig, firelookout.com, the Idaho St. Joe-Clearwater page and the Forest Service list give 1933. The Idaho Selway page and the Forest Lookouts entry give 1934. The story uses 1933 and reports the 1934 dates.

Pole (firelookout.com, Idaho St. Joe-Clearwater page, Forest Service list), log (Hartig) and round timber (Forest Lookouts) all describe a 30-foot tower with an L-4 cab. The story uses pole, the wording most sources give, and notes the others.

notes_for_editor: Core facts (30-foot tower, burned in the August 1934 Pete King Fire, gone) agree across five sources. Dates (1933 versus 1934) and tower material (pole, log, round timber) disagree; both are in the story. Staffing dates come from Hartig's 1981 account alone. Other Grouse Points are in the same sources and were not used: a Clearwater NF entry 6 miles south of Powell RS (L-4 tower, 1934, burned 1934) on the Forest Service list and the Forest Lookouts list, and an FFLA index entry at 46.41048, -114.69014. The Lessons Learned page covers the fire, not the lookout. The brief county 'Idaho' is corrected to Idaho County.
